visual_identity.core_identity: A dead ogre animated into a slow hulking corpse, preserving huge ogre proportions while showing restrained unmistakable undeath.
visual_identity.silhouette: Massive slumped giant with drooping shoulders, uneven gait, thick limbs, and dragging chains.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad ogre face with sunken eyes and slack jaw; damaged but recognizable and non-gory.
visual_identity.body_shape: Huge heavy ogre frame with sagging posture, stiff joints, and asymmetrical undead movement.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse torn skin, a few exposed bone edges or stitched tears, kept clean and non-gory for coloring.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Heavy slumped stance with stiff asymmetrical movement and full ground support.
behavior_style: standing vacant in a ruined holding area

accuracy_checks: ogre scale and bulk remain intact

known_failure_modes.symptom: ogre zombie loses flesh and becomes skeleton
known_failure_modes.correction: restore massive ogre corpse anatomy with only restrained damage
simplify wounds to sparse tears, exposed edges, and slack undead posture
